id: 05_Laser Cutter 5 xTool Studio Design Set Up
title: 激光切割机：加工参数设置（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/05_Laser Cutter 5 xTool Studio Design Set Up.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/05_Laser Cutter 5 xTool Studio Design Set Up（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行
points.K8: 应用预设，参数自动设好
points.K9: 有预设不等于允许加工
points.K11: 切割测试：找能切透的组合
points.K12: 雕刻测试：找合适的深浅
points.K13: 逐个步骤设置加工方式
points.S3: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台桌面式激光切割机和一台电脑旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter connected to a computer with a blank screen and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光切割机的参数设置。
overlay: 激光切割机：加工参数设置

shots.scene: 材料板、滑块、方格三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a wooden sheet, a pair of slider controls and a small grid of squares. No people.
shots.narration: 选模式、选材料、调参数，再试一试。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张木板，站在激光切割机前，挠头看着空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a thin wooden sheet in front of a desktop laser cutter and scratches his head at a blank computer screen.
shots.narration: 阿杰画好了徽章，却不知道参数怎么设。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手想直接按开始键，小研拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for the start button on the laser cutter; the female graduate student gently stops his hand.
shots.narration: 他想直接开机，小研拦住了他。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 参数不对，轻则切不透，重则冒火。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上显示机内蜂窝板的实时画面图示
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a simple live camera view of a honeycomb grid bed inside a laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 连上切割机，软件里能看到机内画面。

shots.scene: 屏幕上的图案框正好叠在木板图像上
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a blank design outline is dragged to sit neatly over the image of a wooden sheet on the grid bed. No people.
shots.narration: 图案放在哪，一眼就能对准材料。

shots.section_title: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行
shots.scene: 屏幕角落两个设备图标，各带一个绿点
shots.prompt_en: Two small device icons in the corner of a blank screen, a laser cutter icon and an air purifier icon, each with a green dot. No people.
shots.narration: 开始前，看两个绿点。
overlay: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行

shots.section_title: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行
shots.scene: 小研指着屏幕上的两个绿点讲解
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at two green status dots on a blank computer screen while the young male student watches.
shots.narration: 一个是切割机，一个是烟尘净化器。

shots.section_title: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行
shots.scene: 其中一个绿点变灰，切割机图标上出现暂停符号
shots.prompt_en: One status dot turns grey, and the laser cutter icon shows a pause symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 缺一个，机器都不会运行。

shots.section_title: 设备和净化器都就绪才运行
shots.scene: 阿杰请老李过来检查连接
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves the facility engineer over; the facility engineer checks the cable behind the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 看不到绿点，请管理人员来检查。

shots.scene: 屏幕上的图形一部分变紫，一部分是红色
shots.prompt_en: A blank design canvas where some simple shapes are purple and others are red. No people.
shots.narration: 图形可以换颜色。

shots.scene: 按颜色一点，所有紫色图形同时被选中
shots.prompt_en: A cursor clicks a purple swatch and all purple shapes on the canvas get selection boxes at once. No people.
shots.narration: 同色的对象，一点就能全部选中。

shots.scene: 颜色色板旁，切割结果图标没有变化，打等号
shots.prompt_en: A color palette icon next to two identical cut wooden pieces with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色不影响加工，也不等于组合。

shots.scene: 屏幕上弹出几张加工模式卡片，蜂窝板卡片高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank pop-up window with several mode cards, the honeycomb bed card highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 加工模式，默认是蜂窝板。

shots.scene: 薄木板平放在蜂窝板上
shots.prompt_en: A thin wooden sheet lies flat on a honeycomb grid bed inside an open laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 绝大多数时候，用它就对了。

shots.scene: 拆掉板条后，一个较厚的木块放在机内底部
shots.prompt_en: Inside a laser cutter with the support slats removed, a thick wooden block sits on the bottom tray. No people.
shots.narration: 在较厚物体上只雕刻，用拆板条模式。

shots.scene: 一排相同的书签图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of identical blank bookmark icons. No people.
shots.narration: 同一个设计要做很多份，

shots.scene: 一排钥匙扣图标，上面依次是1、2、3
shots.prompt_en: A row of keychain icons, each with a different small number from 1 to 5. No people.
shots.narration: 或者每份稍有不同，可以用批量加工。

shots.scene: 旋转附件和送料器两个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a rotary attachment and a conveyor feeder, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 软件里有、机房没有的附件，

shots.scene: 切割机图标头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: A laser cutter icon with a big question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 不要选，选了只会让机器出错。

shots.scene: 屏幕上一列材料卡片，其中一张木板卡片被选中
shots.prompt_en: A blank pop-up list of material cards with small pictures; one plywood card is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用有预设的材料，就在列表里选。

shots.scene: 三块厚度不同的木板并排，用尺子比较
shots.prompt_en: Three wooden sheets of different thickness side by side with a ruler beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种木板，厚度不同，参数也不同。

shots.scene: 小研用卡尺量木板厚度，阿杰记下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student measures a wooden sheet with calipers while the young male student takes notes on a blank pad.
shots.narration: 厚度选错，功率速度就都不对。

shots.section_title: 应用预设，参数自动设好
shots.scene: 鼠标点击空白的应用按钮
shots.prompt_en: A cursor clicks a blank apply button on a pop-up window. No people.
shots.narration: 选好后点应用。
overlay: 应用预设，参数自动设好

shots.section_title: 应用预设，参数自动设好
shots.scene: 右侧步骤列表的滑块自动跳到新位置
shots.prompt_en: A side panel with three blank step rows; their slider controls jump to new positions. No people.
shots.narration: 每个步骤的功率和速度，自动设好。

shots.section_title: 有预设不等于允许加工
shots.scene: 材料列表中出现石头和硅胶图标
shots.prompt_en: A material list showing stone and silicone pad icons among wood icons. No people.
shots.narration: 软件列出的材料，不一定都能切。
overlay: 有预设不等于允许加工

shots.section_title: 有预设不等于允许加工
shots.scene: 石头和硅胶图标被红叉划掉，旁边是空白清单
shots.prompt_en: Stone and silicone pad icons crossed out with a red X next to a blank approved list with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 不在许可清单里的，一律不放进机器。

shots.section_title: 有预设不等于允许加工
shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上的空白材料许可清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank approved materials chart on the wall beside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 能不能用，看清单，不看软件。

shots.section_title: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块透明塑料片，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a plain clear plastic sheet with a serious face.
shots.narration: 有一类材料，绝对不能切。
overlay: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切

shots.section_title: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切
shots.scene: 塑料板图标冒出黄绿色烟雾，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A plastic sheet icon releasing a yellow-green cloud next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯塑料一切，就会放出有毒腐蚀气体。

shots.section_title: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切
shots.scene: 烟雾飘向人形图标和机器镜片图标
shots.prompt_en: The yellow-green cloud drifts toward a person pictogram and a laser lens icon. No people.
shots.narration: 伤人，也腐蚀机器。

shots.section_title: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切
shots.scene: 没有标签的材料图标打问号再打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled sheet icon with a question mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 说不清成分的材料，也一律不切。

shots.section_title: 材料限制：含氯材料禁切
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一块不明材料去问老李
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows an unlabeled sheet to the facility engineer, who shakes his head.
shots.narration: 拿不准，先问管理人员。

shots.section_title: 有预设不等于允许加工
shots.scene: 小研把一张薄木板平放进切割机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays a thin wooden sheet flat onto the honeycomb bed inside the open laser cutter.
shots.narration: 确认是许可材料，再放进机器。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在打开的切割机旁，举着空白检查卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an open desktop laser cutter holding a blank checklist card.
shots.narration: 放材料前，先做开机前检查。

shots.scene: 蜂窝板稳稳落在导轨支架上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A honeycomb grid bed resting properly on its rail holders inside the laser cutter, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 蜂窝板放在支架上，放平放稳。

shots.scene: 机内残渣碎屑图标被扫掉
shots.prompt_en: Small scrap pieces and dust inside the laser cutter are swept out with a small brush. No people.
shots.narration: 清掉上次留下的碎屑和残渣。

shots.scene: 镜片图标干净发亮，旁边是排风管
shots.prompt_en: A clean shiny laser lens icon next to an exhaust duct icon with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片干净，排风或净化器正常。

shots.scene: 红色急停按钮和关好的盖板图标
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button icon and a closed lid icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 急停好用，盖板关得严。

shots.scene: 小研按切割机上的测距键，激光头下移
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a button on the laser cutter; the laser head moves down toward the wooden sheet.
shots.narration: 按说明书测距或对焦。

shots.scene: 焦点没对准时边缘发黑发糊的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blurry blackened cut edge crossed out with a red X, next to a crisp clean cut with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 焦点不准，切不透还容易烧焦。

shots.scene: 两个压块把翘起的木板压平
shots.prompt_en: Two small weights hold a slightly warped wooden sheet flat on the grid bed. No people.
shots.narration: 翘起的材料要压平，别碰到激光头。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个空白的方格网图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a big blank grid of squares on a board.
shots.narration: 没有预设的材料，怎么找参数？

shots.scene: 屏幕弹出空白对话框，三个图标：刀、笔刷、虚线
shots.prompt_en: A blank dialog window with three option icons: a cutting line, an engraving brush and a dashed scoring line. No people.
shots.narration: 打开材料测试阵列，先选加工方式。

shots.scene: 木头、塑料、纸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: wood, plastic and paper. No people.
shots.narration: 再选材料的大类。

shots.scene: 两组滑块分别标出上下限
shots.prompt_en: Two pairs of blank slider controls, each with a low mark and a high mark. No people.
shots.narration: 设好功率和速度的上限、下限。

shots.scene: 方格网按行列展开
shots.prompt_en: A grid of small squares expanding into rows and columns. No people.
shots.narration: 定好行数列数，生成测试方格。

shots.scene: 方格从浅绿变成亮蓝色
shots.prompt_en: The grid of squares changes color from pale green to bright blue on a dark background. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色看不清，可以换个醒目的颜色。

shots.section_title: 切割测试：找能切透的组合
shots.scene: 方格横轴是速度箭头，纵轴是功率箭头
shots.prompt_en: A grid of squares with a speed arrow along one side and a power arrow along the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 一边是速度，一边是功率。
overlay: 切割测试：找能切透的组合

shots.section_title: 切割测试：找能切透的组合
shots.scene: 木板上有的方块掉了出来，有的还连着
shots.prompt_en: A wooden test sheet where some square pieces have dropped out cleanly and others are still attached. No people.
shots.narration: 切完一看，哪些切透了一目了然。

shots.section_title: 切割测试：找能切透的组合
shots.scene: 一块方格被放大镜圈出，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass highlights one cleanly cut square with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 选能切透、边缘又干净的那一格。

shots.section_title: 雕刻测试：找合适的深浅
shots.scene: 阿杰举着一块雕刻很浅的木牌皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a wooden tag with a very faint engraving and frowns.
shots.narration: 雕得太浅，想更深更暗怎么办？
overlay: 雕刻测试：找合适的深浅

shots.section_title: 雕刻测试：找合适的深浅
shots.scene: 木板上的方格由浅到深排列
shots.prompt_en: A wooden test sheet with engraved squares going from very light to very dark. No people.
shots.narration: 跑一次雕刻测试，深浅排成一排。

shots.section_title: 雕刻测试：找合适的深浅
shots.scene: 阿杰指着中间深浅合适的一格，满意点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a medium dark square on the test sheet and nods happily.
shots.narration: 看着方格挑，最合心意。

shots.section_title: 逐个步骤设置加工方式
shots.scene: 右侧面板三行空白步骤，各有下拉菜单
shots.prompt_en: A side panel with three blank step rows, each with a drop-down menu. No people.
shots.narration: 没有预设，就要逐个步骤设置。
overlay: 逐个步骤设置加工方式

shots.section_title: 逐个步骤设置加工方式
shots.scene: 一张照片图标只连着笔刷图标
shots.prompt_en: A photo icon linked only to an engraving brush icon. No people.
shots.narration: 图片只能雕刻。

shots.section_title: 逐个步骤设置加工方式
shots.scene: 圆形和猫形轮廓连着刀、笔刷、虚线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A circle outline and a cat silhouette outline each linked to three icons: a cutting line, an engraving brush and a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 线条图形，可选划线、雕刻或切割。

shots.section_title: 逐个步骤设置加工方式
shots.scene: 小研拖动功率和速度滑块，旁边放着测试木板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts two slider controls on a blank screen with the tested wooden grid sheet beside the keyboard.
shots.narration: 再按测试结果，填好功率和速度。

shots.scene: 三行步骤中，只有雕刻那行的滑块在动
shots.prompt_en: Three blank step rows; only the engraving row's sliders move while the others stay still. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以只调其中一个步骤。

shots.scene: 功率箭头向上，速度箭头向下，雕刻图标变深
shots.prompt_en: A power arrow pointing up, a speed arrow pointing down, and an engraving icon turning darker. No people.
shots.narration: 想雕深一点，加点功率、放慢速度。

shots.scene: 切割那行保持默认值打勾
shots.prompt_en: The cutting step row keeps its default setting with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 切割照用默认，各管各的。

shots.scene: 新加的星形连到已有的切割步骤上
shots.prompt_en: A new star shape is added to the canvas and snaps into the existing cutting step row. No people.
shots.narration: 设置相同的对象，会并进同一步骤。

shots.scene: 星形改为划线后，列表多出一行
shots.prompt_en: The star shape is switched to scoring and a new step row appears in the list. No people.
shots.narration: 设成新方式，就多出一个步骤。

shots.scene: 步骤卡片顺序打乱后自动排好
shots.prompt_en: Shuffled blank step cards rearrange themselves into neat order with a gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序不用管，软件会自动排好。

shots.scene: 净化器图标运转，烟雾被吸进管道
shots.prompt_en: An air purifier icon running, with smoke drawn from the laser cutter through a duct into it. No people.
shots.narration: 加工会产生烟尘，净化器全程开着。

shots.scene: 辅助气泵图标吹向加工点
shots.prompt_en: A small air pump icon blowing a stream of air toward the cutting point under the laser head. No people.
shots.narration: 按提示打开辅助吹气，减少火苗烟渣。

shots.scene: 加工完立即开盖、烟雾外冒的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laser cutter lid opened right after a job with smoke pouring out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加工完稍等，烟尘排净再开盖。

shots.scene: 小研站在运行的切割机前，透过观察窗看着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a running desktop laser cutter and watches through the tinted viewing window.
shots.narration: 测试方格也是真加工，要全程看守。

shots.scene: 人离开、机器独自运行的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking away from a running laser cutter, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 机器运行，人不离开。

shots.scene: 小研手指放在急停按钮旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps her hand near the red emergency stop button while watching the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 一有明火或异常，立即按停。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一枚空白的木质徽章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank round wooden badge.
shots.narration: 下一课，完整做一枚徽章。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现蜂窝板、木板、滑块图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a honeycomb bed, a wooden sheet and slider controls.
shots.narration: 两个绿点都亮，模式选蜂窝板。

shots.scene: 木板加尺子、清单打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wooden sheet with a ruler and a blank checklist with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 材料厚度选对，许可清单为准。

shots.scene: 含氯塑料图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A plastic sheet icon with a yellow-green cloud crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯塑料和不明材料，一律不切。

shots.scene: 方格网图标和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A grid of squares icon with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 没预设先跑测试方格，再定参数。

shots.scene: 净化器、眼睛、急停三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an air purifier, an eye and a red emergency stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 开净化器，盯着机器，随时急停。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好的切割机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy closed desktop laser cutter.
shots.narration: 参数设对，切得安心，下次见！
